stt: Ask HN: What are you reading to your kids?
x:
I think I read "Goodnight Moon" to our son every evening for three years - to the extent I got a red balloon tattoo.

After that we moved on to Aku Ankka (Donald Duck) cartoons, The Hobbit, and a lot of stories from Enid Blyton.

These days he's reading a lot of Harry Potter, and likes to have bits of encyclopedias read to him.  We pick a topic and read for as long as he's interested.  Flipping around to follow references and talk about them.
